strings.один из шести людей, присутствовавших на: one of six men present at the court of the Yaroslavl tiun
strings.Самостоятельный носитель редкого имени А: An independent bearer of the rare name Anfilof c. 1495–1497. He lived in the right chronological layer, but is found in Yaroslavl uyezd, not Tver uyezd; his identity with the eponym of Onfilogovo is not proven.
strings.В конце правой грамоты стоит формула: «А: At the end of the judgment charter stands the formula: «А на суде были Гордин соцкой, да Григорей Ярцев, да Мита Галасьев, да Лука Максимов, да Клим Давыдов, да Анфилоф Селиванов» ["And present at the court were Gordin the sotsky, and Grigorei Yartsev, and Mita Galasyev, and Luka Maksimov, and Klim Davydov, and Anfilof Selivanov"]. Anfilof is named sixth and last in the list. This reading has been checked against the facsimile of printed pages 218–219, not taken only from the name index.
strings.Издатели датировали акт приблизительно 1: The editors dated the act to approximately 1495–1497 on the basis of its participants and procedural circumstances. Anfilof was an adult capable of attending an official land court, some 42–45 years before the first description of Onfilogovo in Tver. By generation he fits the time when the already established name of the village arose.
strings.Суд происходил в Ярославском уезде и кас: The court sat in Yaroslavl uyezd and concerned the Krestsy hayfield on the Kotorosl river, which was disputed with the Spaso-Yaroslavsky Monastery. The exact location of the hayfield has not been reconstructed; the map places a cautious marker at the monastery and does not present it as Anfilof's homestead or land.
strings.Что означает «на суде были»: What «на суде были» ["present at the court were"] means
strings.Формула перечисляет присутствующих при р: The formula lists the people present at the proceedings. The name index of the edition describes Anfilof as a «муж» ["man"] at the court of the Yaroslavl tiun — a participant in the judicial procedure, possibly a witness (poslukh) or an assessor from the local community. The text itself does not call him plaintiff, defendant, judge, scribe, or owner of the disputed hayfield.
strings.Можно ли назвать его крестьянином: Can he be called a peasant?
strings.Нет, пока нельзя. В отличие от Тонкого О: No, not yet. Unlike Tonkoi Onfilogov, whom the scribe placed in a list of monastery households, Anfilof Selivanov's social status is not given in this line. He could have belonged to local landholders, service people, or well-off peasants, but choosing one version over another without a further act would be invention.
strings.Анфилоф — личное мужское имя; Селиванов: Anfilof is a male personal name; Selivanov is a second name in -ov, most naturally linked to a father or senior person named Selivan. In the late 15th century this was not necessarily a hereditary surname of the modern type. The literal reading could have sounded like «Анфилоф, Селиванов [сын]» ["Anfilof, Selivan's [son]"].
strings.Почему форма Анфилоф важна для Онфилогов: Why the form Anfilof matters for Onfilogovo
strings.Она показывает живой вариант того же ред: It shows a living variant of the same rare name cluster: Anfilof — Onfilog — Anfilog. Shifts of initial A-/O-, wavering between final -f/-g, and the insertion of -l-/-log occur when scribes and everyday speech rendered an unfamiliar church name. The coincidence does not prove one and the same person, but it makes the reconstruction of the name from the toponym considerably more reliable.
strings.Анфилоф Селиванов назван лично и примерн: Anfilof Selivanov is named personally and about forty years earlier than Tonkoi; Tonkoi, however, gives the form Onfilogov, almost literally matching the stem of the toponym, and points to another Onfilog of the preceding generation. The first candidate is stronger as a direct bearer of the name in the right era, the second as an exact phonetic match. Both lack a personal link to Tver.
strings.Почему это не найденный основатель: Why this is not the founder found
strings.Документ связывает Анфилофа с судебным с: The document connects Anfilof with a court event on the Kotorosl in Yaroslavl uyezd, not with Nikolskoye Svechino, Khorvach volost, or Tver uyezd. The act contains no Onfilogovo, no Yurlovs, and no land transfer. Therefore the man cannot be moved 170–200 km and declared the eponym merely because of a rare name and a fitting date.
strings.Нужен второй акт, где Анфилоф Селиванов: A second act is needed in which Anfilof Selivanov or his children appear in Tver uyezd, alongside the Yurlovs, at Nikolskoye Svechino, or in a chain of land transfer. Documents revealing his patronymic, holdings, and kin would also be useful. For now his status is a confirmed bearer of the name and a candidate for further checking, but not the founder.

strings.Около 1495—1497 годов судья — ярославски: Around 1495–1497 the judge — the Yaroslavl tiun Afanasy Durov — heard the dispute of the Spaso-Yaroslavsky Monastery with Mikitka Levonov over the Krestsy hayfield on the Kotorosl river. After the decision in favour of the monastery, the act lists six men who were present at the court; the last named is Anfilof Selivanov. The formula proves the existence of a real layman with a rare name in the generation suitable for the emergence of the name Onfilogovo. It does not call him a peasant, owner, or founder and does not connect him with Tver uyezd.
strings.Около 1495—1497 годов Анфилоф Селиванов: Around 1495–1497 Anfilof Selivanov was one of six men present at the court of the Yaroslavl tiun Afanasy Durov in the dispute over the Krestsy hayfield on the Kotorosl. He is the direct and earliest personal bearer found of the rare form Anfilof in the relevant generation. A geographical link with Onfilogovo in Tver has not been established.
strings.Генеалогически значимая часть записи рас: The genealogically significant part of the record has been transcribed.
strings.Не установлены социальное положение, отч: Anfilof Selivanov's social status, patronymic, age, and holdings have not been established.
strings.Не найдена связь с Тверским уездом, Юрло: No link with Tver uyezd, the Yurlovs, or Nikolskoye Svechino has been found.
strings.Точная локализация пожни Крестцы у Котор: The exact location of the Krestsy hayfield on the Kotorosl has not been reconstructed.
